test_sql_except: test the SQL EXCEPT set operation that returns rows from the first query not present in the second
test_sql_intersect: test the SQL INTERSECT set operation that returns rows common to both queries
test_sql_except_by_name: test the SQL EXCEPT BY NAME operation that matches columns by name instead of position
test_sql_intersect_by_name: test the SQL INTERSECT BY NAME operation that matches columns by name instead of position
test_sql_union: test the SQL UNION set operation that combines rows from two queries with DISTINCT or ALL variants
